The categories '症状' (Symptom) and '其他治疗' (Other Treatment) are omitted from this list.
The y-axis (value axis) does not have a label in the figure.
This describes the range of the data values, not the y-axis scale. The y-axis scale ranges from 0 to 6000.
The chart contains nine bars, not seven.
The longest bar represents the category '症状' (Symptom), not '疾病' (Disease).
